policies.text: Refund window for annual plans is 30 days from purchase.
Monthly plans can be refunded within the first 7 days.
Data exports are delivered as CSV within 24 hours.
Support hours are 08:00-20:00 UTC on weekdays.
SSO is available on the Business plan and above.

questions.ask: How long is the refund window for annual plans?
Can a monthly plan be refunded?
How fast are data exports delivered?

admin_edit.text: Refund window for annual plans is 14 days from purchase.
admin_edit.why: the admin tool saves the new refund policy

channel.name: billing-policy channel
channel.text: Priya Nand (billing lead, Harlow Desk): Finance update, effective today: the refund window for annual plans is now 21 days from purchase, and data exports now take up to 48 hours.

retire.why: monthly plans are no longer refundable; the policy is retired

A.how: keyed by question text; an entry is used for 15 minutes
